359: struct_with_invariants!{
360: pub tracked struct ContextGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
361:     pub batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
362: 
363:     pub slots: FlatCombiner::slots,
364: 
365:     pub update: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>
366: }
367: 
368: pub open spec fn inv(&self, v: u64, tid: nat, cell: PCell<PendingOperation<DT>>, fc: FlatCombiner::Instance, inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>) -> bool {
369:     predicate {
370:         &&& self.slots.key() == tid
371:         &&& self.slots.instance_id() == fc.id()
372: 
373:         &&& ((v == 0) || (v == 1))
374:         &&& (v == 0 ==> self.slots.value().is_Empty() || self.slots.value().is_Response())
375:         &&& (v == 1 ==> self.slots.value().is_Request() || self.slots.value().is_InProgress())
376: 
377:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Empty() ==> {
378:             &&& self.update.is_none()
379:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
380:         })
381: 
382:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Request() ==> {
383:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
384:             &&& update.value().is_Init()
385:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
386:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
387: 
388:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
389:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
390:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
391:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().op == update.value().get_Init_op()
392:         })
393: 
394:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_InProgress() ==> {
395:             &&& self.update.is_none()
396:             &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
397:         })
398: 
399:         &&& (self.slots.value().is_Response() ==> {
400:             &&& self.update matches Some(update)
401:             &&& update.value().is_Done()
402:             &&& update.key() == self.slots.value().get_ReqId()
403:             &&& update.instance_id() == inst.id()
404: 
405:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
406:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
407:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == cell.id()
408:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().value().resp matches Some(resp)
409:             &&& resp == update.value().get_Done_ret()
410:         })
411:     }
412: }
413: }

416: pub tracked struct FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT: Dispatch> {
417:     pub tracked batch_perms: Option<PointsTo<PendingOperation<DT>>>,
418:     pub tracked cell_id: Ghost<CellId>,
419:     pub tracked local_updates: Option<UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>,
420:     pub tracked fc_clients: FlatCombiner::clients,
421: }
422: 
423: impl<DT: Dispatch> FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT> {
424:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_pre(
425:         &self,
426:         tid: nat,
427:         op: DT::WriteOperation,
428:         batch_cell: CellId,
429:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
430:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
431:     ) -> bool {
432:         &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
433:         &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
434:         &&& local_updates.value().is_Init()
435:         &&& local_updates.value().get_Init_op() == op
436:         &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
437:         &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
438:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
439:         &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
440:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
441:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
442:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
443:     }
444: 
445:     pub open spec fn enqueue_op_post(&self, pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>) -> bool
446:         recommends
447:             pre.local_updates.is_some(),
448:     {
449:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
450:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0() == pre.local_updates.unwrap().key()
451:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
452:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
453:         &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
454:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
455:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
456:     }
457: 
458:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_pre(
459:         &self,
460:         batch_cell: CellId,
461:         tid: nat,
462:         fc_inst: FlatCombiner::Instance,
463:     ) -> bool {
464:         &&& self.fc_clients.key() == tid
465:         &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == fc_inst.id()
466:         &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Waiting()
467:         &&& self.batch_perms.is_none()
468:         &&& self.local_updates.is_none()
469:         &&& self.cell_id == batch_cell
470:     }
471: 
472:     pub open spec fn dequeue_resp_post(
473:         &self,
474:         pre: FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>,
475:         ret: Option<DT::Response>,
476:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
477:     ) -> bool {
478:         &&& ret matches Some(ret) ==> {
479:             &&& self.cell_id == pre.cell_id
480:             &&& self.batch_perms matches Some(batch_perms)
481:             &&& batch_perms.mem_contents().is_uninit()
482:             &&& batch_perms@.pcell == self.cell_id
483:             &&& self.local_updates matches Some(local_updates)
484:             &&& local_updates.instance_id() == inst.id()
485:             &&& local_updates.value().is_Done()
486:             &&& local_updates.key() == pre.fc_clients.value().get_Waiting_0()
487:             &&& local_updates.value().get_Done_ret() == ret
488:             &&& self.fc_clients.instance_id() == pre.fc_clients.instance_id()
489:             &&& self.fc_clients.key() == pre.fc_clients.key()
490:             &&& self.fc_clients.value().is_Idle()
491:         }
492:         &&& ret.is_none() ==> {
493:             &&& self == pre
494:         }
495:     }
496: }
497: 
498: }

579:     pub                    local_versions: Vec<CachePadded<AtomicU64<_, (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>), _>>>,

587: pub open spec fn wf(&self) -> bool {
588:     predicate {
589:         &&& 0 < self.num_replicas@ <=  MAX_REPLICAS
590: 
591:         &&& self.local_versions.len() == self.num_replicas
592: 
593:         &&& self.slog.len() == LOG_SIZE
594:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.buffer_size()
595:         &&& self.slog.len() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids().len()
596:         &&& (forall |i| #![trigger self.slog[i]] 0 <= i < self.slog.len() ==> {
597:             &&& self.slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger]self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.cell_ids()[i])
598:         })
599: 
600:         &&& (forall |i: nat| i < LOG_SIZE ==> (#[trigger] self.slog[i as int]).wf(i, self.cyclic_buffer_instance@))
601: 
602:         &&& self.unbounded_log_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
603:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.num_replicas() == self.num_replicas
604:         &&& self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.unbounded_log_instance() == self.unbounded_log_instance
605:     }
606: 
607:     invariant on version_upper_bound with (unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.version_upper_bound.0) is (v: u64, g: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>) {
608:         &&& g.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
609:         &&& g.value() == v
610:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
611:     }
612: 
613:     invariant on head with (cyclic_buffer_instance) specifically (self.head.0) is (v: u64, g: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>) {
614:         &&& g.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
615:         &&& g.value() == v
616:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
617:     }
618: 
619:     invariant on tail with (cyclic_buffer_instance, unbounded_log_instance) specifically (self.tail.0) is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::tail<DT>, CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>)) {
620:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
621:         &&& g.0.value() == v
622:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
623:         &&& g.1.value() == v
624:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
625:     }
626: 
627:     invariant on local_versions with (unbounded_log_instance, cyclic_buffer_instance)
628:         forall |i: int|
629:         where (0 <= i < self.local_versions@.len())
630:         specifically (self.local_versions@[i].0)
631:         is (v: u64, g: (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>)) {
632: 
633:         &&& g.0.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance@.id()
634:         &&& g.0.key() == i
635:         &&& g.0.value() == v
636:         &&& g.1.instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance@.id()
637:         &&& g.1.key() == i
638:         &&& g.1.value() == v
639:         &&& 0 <= v <= MAX_IDX
640:     }
641: }
642: }

645: impl<DT: Dispatch> NrLog<DT> {
646:     pub fn new(num_replicas: usize, log_size: usize) -> (res: (
647:         Self,
648:         Vec<ReplicaToken>,
649:         Tracked<NrLogTokens<DT>>,
650:     ))
651:         requires
652:             log_size == LOG_SIZE,
653:             0 < num_replicas && num_replicas <= MAX_REPLICAS,
654:         ensures
655:             res.0.wf(),
656:             res.0.unbounded_log_instance@ == res.2@.unbounded_log_instance,
657:             res.0.cyclic_buffer_instance@ == res.2@.cyclic_buffer_instance,
658:             res.1.len() == num_replicas,
659:             forall|i| #![trigger res.1[i]] 0 <= i < num_replicas ==> res.1[i].id_spec() == i,
660:             res.2@.wf(num_replicas as nat),
661:     {
662:         let tracked unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>;
663:         let tracked ul_tail: UnboundedLog::tail<DT>;
664:         let tracked ul_replicas: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::replicas<DT>>;
665:         let tracked mut ul_local_versions: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>>;
666:         let tracked ul_version_upper_bound: UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>;
667:         let tracked ul_combiner: Map<NodeId, UnboundedLog::combiner<DT>>;
668:         proof {
669:             let tracked (
670:                 Tracked(unbounded_log_instance0),  
671:                 Tracked(ul_log0),  
672:                 Tracked(ul_tail0),  
673:                 Tracked(ul_replicas0),  
674:                 Tracked(ul_local_versions0),  
675:                 Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound0),  
676:                 _,  
677:                 _,  
678:                 Tracked(ul_combiner0),  
679:             ) = UnboundedLog::Instance::initialize(num_replicas as nat);
680:             unbounded_log_instance = unbounded_log_instance0;
681:             ul_tail = ul_tail0;
682:             ul_replicas = ul_replicas0.into_map();
683:             ul_local_versions = ul_local_versions0.into_map();
684:             ul_version_upper_bound = ul_version_upper_bound0;
685:             ul_combiner = ul_combiner0.into_map();
686:         }
687:         let ghost mut logical_log_idx;
688:         proof {
689:             logical_log_idx = -log_size as int;
690:         }
691:         let mut slog_entries: Vec<Option<PCell<Option<ConcreteLogEntry<DT>>>>> = Vec::with_capacity(
692:             log_size,
693:         );
694:         let ghost mut cell_ids: Seq<CellId> = Seq::empty();
695:         let tracked mut contents: Map<LogicalLogIdx, StoredType<DT>> = Map::tracked_empty();
696:         let mut log_idx = 0;
697:         while log_idx < log_size
698:             invariant
699:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,
700:                 log_size == LOG_SIZE,
701:                 logical_log_idx == log_idx - log_size,
702:                 -log_size <= logical_log_idx <= 0,
703:                 slog_entries.len() == log_idx,
704:                 cell_ids.len() == log_idx,
705:                 forall|i| 0 <= i < log_idx ==> (#[trigger] slog_entries[i]).is_some(),
706:                 forall|i|
707:                     0 <= i < log_idx ==> #[trigger] cell_ids[i] == (
708:                     #[trigger] slog_entries[i]).unwrap().id(),
709:                 forall|i| -log_size <= i < logical_log_idx <==> #[trigger] contents.contains_key(i),
710:                 forall|i| #[trigger]
711:                     contents.contains_key(i) ==> stored_type_inv(
712:                         contents[i],
713:                         i,
714:                         cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, log_size as nat) as int],
715:                         unbounded_log_instance,
716:                     ),
717:             decreases log_size - log_idx
718:         {
719:             let (pcell, token) = PCell::new(Option::None);
720:             proof {
721:                 cell_ids = cell_ids.push(pcell.id());
722:             }
723:             slog_entries.push(Option::Some(pcell));
724:             let tracked stored_type = StoredType {
725:                 cell_perms: token.get(),
726:                 log_entry: Option::None,
727:             };
728:             proof {
729:                 contents.tracked_insert(logical_log_idx, stored_type);
730:             }
731:             log_idx = log_idx + 1;
732:             proof {
733:                 logical_log_idx = logical_log_idx + 1;
734:             }
735:         }
736: 
737:         let tracked cyclic_buffer_instance: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>;
738:         let tracked cb_head: CyclicBuffer::head<DT>;
739:         let tracked cb_tail: CyclicBuffer::tail<DT>;
740:         let tracked mut cb_local_versions: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>>;
741:         let tracked mut cb_alive_bits: Map<LogIdx, CyclicBuffer::alive_bits<DT>>;
742:         let tracked cb_combiners: Map<NodeId, CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>;
743:         proof {
744:             let tracked (
745:                 Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance0),  
746:                 Tracked(cb_head0),  
747:                 Tracked(cb_tail0),  
748:                 Tracked(cb_local_versions0),  
749:                 Tracked(cb_alive_bits0),  
750:                 Tracked(cb_combiner0),  
751:             ) = CyclicBuffer::Instance::initialize(
752:                 log_size as nat,
753:                 num_replicas as nat,
754:                 contents,
755:                 cell_ids,
756:                 unbounded_log_instance,
757:                 contents,
758:             );
759:             cyclic_buffer_instance = cyclic_buffer_instance0;
760:             cb_head = cb_head0;
761:             cb_tail = cb_tail0;
762:             cb_local_versions = cb_local_versions0.into_map();
763:             cb_alive_bits = cb_alive_bits0.into_map();
764:             cb_combiners = cb_combiner0.into_map();
765:         }
766:         let mut slog: Vec<BufferEntry<DT>> = Vec::with_capacity(log_size);
767:         let mut log_idx = 0;
768:         while log_idx < log_size
769:             invariant
770:                 0 <= log_idx <= log_size,
771:                 slog_entries.len() == log_size,
772:                 slog.len() == log_idx,
773:                 cell_ids.len() == log_size,
774:                 forall|i|
775:                     #![trigger slog[i]]
776:                     0 <= i < log_idx ==> {
777:                         &&& slog[i].wf(i as nat, cyclic_buffer_instance)
778:                         &&& slog[i].log_entry.id() == (#[trigger] cell_ids[i])
779:                     },
780:                 forall|i| log_idx <= i < log_size ==> cb_alive_bits.contains_key(i),
781:                 forall|i|
782:                     #![trigger cb_alive_bits[i]]
783:                     log_idx <= i < log_size ==> {
784:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].key() == i
785:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].value() == false
786:                         &&& cb_alive_bits[i].instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance.id()
787:                     },
788:                 forall|i| 0 <= i < log_idx ==> slog_entries.spec_index(i).is_none(),
789:                 forall|i|
790:                     #![trigger slog_entries[i]]
791:                     log_idx <= i < log_size ==> {
792:                         &&& slog_entries[i] matches Some(entry)
793:                         &&& entry.id() == cell_ids[i]
794:                     },
795:             decreases log_size - log_idx
796:         {
797:             let tracked cb_alive_bit;
798:             proof {
799:                 cb_alive_bit = cb_alive_bits.tracked_remove(log_idx as nat);
800:             }
801:             let mut log_entry = Option::None;
802:             slog_entries.set_and_swap(log_idx, &mut log_entry);
803:             assert(log_entry.is_some());
804:             let log_entry = log_entry.unwrap();
805:             let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
806:             let entry = BufferEntry {
807:                 log_entry: log_entry,
808:                 alive: AtomicBool::new(
809:                     Ghost((Ghost(log_idx as nat), cb_inst)),
810:                     false,
811:                     Tracked(cb_alive_bit),
812:                 ),
813:                 cyclic_buffer_idx: Ghost(log_idx as nat),
814:                 cyclic_buffer_instance: Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone()),
815:             };
816:             slog.push(entry);
817:             log_idx = log_idx + 1;
818:         }
819:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
820:         let version_upper_bound = CachePadded(
821:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost(ul_inst), 0, Tracked(ul_version_upper_bound)),
822:         );
823:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
824:         let head = CachePadded(AtomicU64::new(Ghost(cb_inst), 0, Tracked(cb_head)));
825:         let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
826:         let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
827:         let tail = CachePadded(
828:             AtomicU64::new(Ghost((cb_inst, ul_inst)), 0, Tracked((ul_tail, cb_tail))),
829:         );
830:         let mut local_versions: Vec<
831:             CachePadded<
832:                 AtomicU64<
833:                     (Tracked<UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>>, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>>, int),
834:                     (UnboundedLog::local_versions<DT>, CyclicBuffer::local_versions<DT>),
835:                     _,
836:                 >,
837:             >,
838:         > = Vec::with_capacity(num_replicas);
839:         let mut nid = 0;
840:         while nid < num_replicas
841:             invariant
842:                 0 <= nid <= num_replicas,
843:                 local_versions.len() == nid,
844:                 forall|i| nid <= i < num_replicas ==> ul_local_versions.contains_key(i),
845:                 forall|i| nid <= i < num_replicas ==> cb_local_versions.contains_key(i),
846:                 forall|i|
847:                     #![trigger cb_local_versions[i]]
848:                     nid <= i < num_replicas ==> {
849:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].instance_id() == cyclic_buffer_instance.id()
850:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].key() == i
851:                         &&& cb_local_versions[i].value() == 0
852:                     },
853:                 forall|i|
854:                     #![trigger ul_local_versions[i]]
855:                     nid <= i < num_replicas ==> {
856:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance.id()
857:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].key() == i
858:                         &&& ul_local_versions[i].value() == 0
859:                     },
860:                 forall|i: int|
861:                     #![trigger local_versions[i]]
862:                     0 <= i < local_versions.len() ==> {
863:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.well_formed()
864:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().0 == unbounded_log_instance
865:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().1 == cyclic_buffer_instance
866:                         &&& local_versions[i].0.constant().2 == i
867:                     },
868:             decreases num_replicas - nid
869:         {
870:             let ghost mut nid_ghost;
871:             let tracked ul_version;
872:             let tracked cb_version;
873:             proof {
874:                 nid_ghost = nid as int;
875:                 ul_version = ul_local_versions.tracked_remove(nid as nat);
876:                 cb_version = cb_local_versions.tracked_remove(nid as nat);
877:             }
878:             let cb_inst = Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance.clone());
879:             let ul_inst = Tracked(unbounded_log_instance.clone());
880:             local_versions.push(
881:                 CachePadded(
882:                     AtomicU64::new(
883:                         Ghost((ul_inst, cb_inst, nid_ghost)),
884:                         0,
885:                         Tracked((ul_version, cb_version)),
886:                     ),
887:                 ),
888:             );
889:             nid = nid + 1;
890:         }
891: 
892:         let mut replica_tokens: Vec<ReplicaToken> = Vec::with_capacity(num_replicas);
893:         let mut idx = 0;
894:         while idx < num_replicas
895:             invariant
896:                 0 <= idx <= num_replicas,
897:                 num_replicas <= MAX_REPLICAS,
898:                 replica_tokens.len() == idx,
899:                 forall|i|
900:                     #![trigger replica_tokens[i]]
901:                     0 <= i < idx ==> replica_tokens[i].id_spec() == i,
902:             decreases num_replicas - idx
903:         {
904:             replica_tokens.push(ReplicaToken::new(idx as ReplicaId));
905:             idx = idx + 1;
906:         }
907:         let ghost mut num_replicas_ghost;
908:         proof { num_replicas_ghost = num_replicas as nat }
909:         ;
910:         let tracked config = NrLogTokens {
911:             num_replicas: num_replicas_ghost,
912:             replicas: ul_replicas,
913:             combiners: ul_combiner,
914:             cb_combiners,
915:             unbounded_log_instance: unbounded_log_instance.clone(),
916:             cyclic_buffer_instance: cyclic_buffer_instance.clone(),
917:         };
918:         let log = NrLog {
919:             slog,
920:             version_upper_bound,
921:             head,
922:             tail,
923:             local_versions,
924:             num_replicas: Ghost(num_replicas as nat),
925:             unbounded_log_instance: Tracked(unbounded_log_instance),
926:             cyclic_buffer_instance: Tracked(cyclic_buffer_instance),
927:         };
928:         (log, replica_tokens, Tracked(config))
929:     }

970:     pub(crate) fn get_version_upper_bound(
971:         &self,
972:         local_reads: Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>,
973:     ) -> (ret: (u64, Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>))
974:         requires
975:             self.wf(),
976:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
977:             local_reads@.value().is_Init(),
978:         ensures
979:             ret.1@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
980:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == ret.0 as nat,
981:             ret.1@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op() == local_reads@.value().get_Init_op(),
982:             ret.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
983:             ret.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
984:     {
985:         let tracked local_reads = local_reads.get();
986:         let ghost rid = local_reads.key();
987:         let tracked new_local_reads_g: UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>;
988:         let res =
989:             atomic_with_ghost!(
990:             &self.version_upper_bound.0 => load();
991:             returning res;
992:             ghost g => {
993:                 new_local_reads_g = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow()
994:                                             .readonly_version_upper_bound(rid, &g, local_reads);
995:             }
996:         );
997:         (res, Tracked(new_local_reads_g))
998:     }

1002:         node_id: ReplicaId,
1003:         version_upper_bound: u64,

1007:             self.wf(),
1008:             node_id < self.local_versions.len(),
1009:             local_reads@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1010:             local_reads@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
1011:             local_reads@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound() == version_upper_bound,
1012:         ensures
1013:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().is_ReadyToRead(),
1014:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().get_ReadyToRead_node_id() == node_id,
1015:             result.0 ==> result.1@.value().get_ReadyToRead_op()
1016:                 == local_reads@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op(),
1017:             !result.0 ==> result.1 == local_reads,
1018:             result.1@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1019:             result.1@.key() == local_reads@.key(),
1020:     {

1031:                         .borrow()

1033:                 } else {
1034:                     local_reads.get()
1035:                 };
1036:             }

1041:     proof fn unbounded_log_append_entries(
1042:         tracked &self,
1043:         nid: nat,
1044:         ridx: nat,
1045:         tracked state: AppendEntriesGhostState<DT>,
1046:     ) -> (tracked ret: AppendEntriesGhostState<DT>)

1048:             self.wf(),
1049:             state.idx == 0,
1050:             state.wf(nid, ridx, self.unbounded_log_instance@),
1051:         ensures
1052:             ret.request_ids == state.request_ids,
1053:             ret.operations == state.operations,
1054:             ret.idx == ridx + 1,
1055:             ret.old_tail == state.old_tail,
1056:             ret.wf(nid, ridx, self.unbounded_log_instance@),
1057:         decreases ridx,
1058:     {
1059:         let tracked mut state = state;
1060:         if ridx != 0 {
1061:             state = self.unbounded_log_append_entries(nid, (ridx - 1) as nat, state);
1062:         }
1063:         let tracked AppendEntriesGhostState {
1064:             idx,
1065:             old_tail,
1066:             mut log_entries,
1067:             mut local_updates,
1068:             combiner,
1069:             mut tail,
1070:             request_ids,
1071:             operations,
1072:         } = state;
1073:         let reqid = request_ids[ridx as int];
1074:         let tracked local_update = local_updates.tracked_remove(ridx);
1075:         let tracked update_result =
1076:             self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().update_place_ops_in_log_one(
1077:             nid as nat,
1078:             reqid,
1079:             &mut tail,
1080:             local_update,
1081:             combiner,

1083:         let tracked combiner = update_result.2.get();
1084:         log_entries.tracked_insert(ridx, update_result.0.get());
1085:         local_updates.tracked_insert(ridx, update_result.1.get());
1086:         let tracked res = AppendEntriesGhostState {
1087:             idx: idx + 1,
1088:             old_tail,
1089:             log_entries,
1090:             local_updates,
1091:             combiner,

1554:     proof fn execute_update_done_multiple(
1555:         tracked &self,
1556:         request_ids: Seq<ReqId>,
1557:         tracked local_updates: Map<nat, UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>,
1558:         tracked version_upper_bound: &UnboundedLog::version_upper_bound<DT>,
1559:     ) -> (tracked res: Map<nat, UnboundedLog::local_updates<DT>>)
1560:         requires
1561:             self.wf(),
1562:             version_upper_bound.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
1563:             forall|i|
1564:                 #![trigger local_updates[i]]
1565:                 0 <= i < request_ids.len() ==> {
1566:                     &&& #[trigger] local_updates.contains_key(i)
1567:                     &&& local_updates[i].key() == request_ids[i as int]
1568:                     &&& local_updates[i].instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id()
1569:                     &&& local_updates[i].value().is_Applied()
1570:                     &&& local_updates[i].value().get_Applied_idx() < version_upper_bound.value()
1571:                 },
1572:         ensures
1573:             forall|i|
1574:                 #![trigger res[i]]
1575:                 0 <= i < request_ids.len() ==> {
1576:                     &&& #[trigger] res.contains_key(i)
1577:                     &&& res[i].key() == request_ids[i as int]
1578:                     &&& res[i].instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id()
1579:                     &&& res[i].value().is_Done()
1580:                     &&& res[i].value().get_Done_ret() == local_updates[i].value().get_Applied_ret()
1581:                 },
1582:         decreases request_ids.len(),
1583:     {
1584:         if request_ids.len() == 0 {
1585:             return local_updates;
1586:         }
1587:         let tracked mut local_updates_new = local_updates;
1588:         let idx = (request_ids.len() - 1) as nat;
1589:         let tracked local_update = local_updates_new.tracked_remove(idx);
1590:         local_updates_new =
1591:         self.execute_update_done_multiple(
1592:             request_ids.subrange(0, request_ids.len() - 1),
1593:             local_updates_new,
1594:             version_upper_bound,
1595:         );
1596:         let tracked update_done_result = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().update_done(
1597:             request_ids.last(),
1598:             version_upper_bound,
1599:             local_update,
1600:         );
1601:         local_updates_new.tracked_insert(idx, update_done_result);
1602:         return local_updates_new;
1603:     }

1643:             if combiner.value().is_Ready() {
1644:                 combiner =
1645:                 self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().exec_trivial_start(nid as nat, combiner);
1646:                 request_ids_new = Seq::empty();
1647:             }
1648:         }
1649:         let mut local_version =
1650:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1651:             &self.local_versions[nid].0 => load();
1652:             returning ret;
1653:             ghost g => {
1654:             }

1656:         let global_tail =
1657:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1658:             &self.tail.0 => load();
1659:             returning global_tail;
1660:             ghost g => {
1661:             }
1662:         );
1663:         if local_version == global_tail {
1664:             let tracked ghost_data_ret = NrLogAppendExecDataGhost {
1665:                 local_updates: Tracked(local_updates),

1679: 
1680:         let ghost local_updates_old = local_updates;

1683:         while local_version < global_tail
1684:             invariant
1685:                 self.wf(),
1686:                 ghost_data.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> {

1703:                 cb_combiner.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),

1707:                 cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Range_end() == global_tail,

1713:                 combiner.value().get_Loop_tail() == global_tail,
1714:                 combiner.value().get_Loop_idx() == responses_idx,
1715:                 forall|i|
1716:                     #![trigger local_updates[i]]
1717:                     responses_idx <= i < request_ids_new.len() ==> {
1718:                         &&& #[trigger ] local_updates.contains_key(i)
1719:                         &&& local_updates[i].key() == request_ids_new[i as int]
1720:                         &&& local_updates[i].value().is_Placed()
1721:                         &&& local_updates[i].instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id()
1722:                     },
1723:                 ghost_data.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> forall|i|
1724:                     #![trigger local_updates[i]]
1725:                     0 <= i < responses_idx ==> {
1726:                         &&& #[trigger] local_updates.contains_key(i)
1727:                         &&& local_updates[i].key() == request_ids_new[i as int]
1728:                         &&& local_updates[i].instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id()
1729:                         &&& local_updates[i].value().is_Applied()
1730:                         &&& local_updates[i].value().get_Applied_ret() == responses[i as int]
1731:                         &&& local_updates[i].value().get_Applied_idx()

1734:             decreases global_tail - local_version
1735:         {

1738:             let mut iteration = 1;
1739:             let mut is_alive = false;

1741:                 invariant
1742:                     self.wf(),
1743:                     local_version < global_tail,
1744:                     phys_log_idx < self.slog.len(),
1745:                     phys_log_idx as nat == self.index_spec(local_version as nat),
1746:                     is_alive_value == self.is_alive_value_spec(local_version as int),
1747:                     0 <= iteration <= WARN_THRESHOLD,
1748:                     cb_combiner.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1749:                     cb_combiner.key() == nid as nat,
1750:                     cb_combiner.value().is_Reading(),
1751:                     !is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().is_Range(),
1752:                     !is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Range_cur()
1753:                         == local_version,
1754:                     !is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Range_end() == global_tail,
1755:                     is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().is_Guard(),
1756:                     is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Guard_cur()
1757:                         == local_version,
1758:                     is_alive ==> cb_combiner.value().get_Reading_0().get_Guard_end() == global_tail,
1759:                     self.slog.spec_index(phys_log_idx as int).wf(
1760:                         phys_log_idx as nat,
1761:                         self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
1762:                     ),
1763:             {
1764:                 if iteration == WARN_THRESHOLD {
1765:                     print_starvation_warning(line!());
1766:                     iteration = 0;
1767:                 }
1768:                 let alive_bit =
1769:                     atomic_with_ghost!(
1770:                     &self.slog[phys_log_idx].alive => load();
1771:                     returning alive_bit;
1772:                     ghost g => {
1773:                     });

1776:             }

1778:             let tracked stored_entry: &StoredType<DT>;
1779:             proof {
1780:                 stored_entry =
1781:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().guard_guards(nid as nat, &cb_combiner);
1782:             }
1783:             let log_entry = self.slog[phys_log_idx].log_entry.borrow(

1797:                         let tracked local_update = local_updates.tracked_remove(

1800:                         let tracked (

1816:                     }

1835:                         assert(false)

1837:                     }
1838:                 }

1840:             proof {
1841:                 cb_combiner =
1842:                 self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow().reader_unguard(nid as nat, cb_combiner);
1843:             }
1844:             local_version = local_version + 1;

1879:     pub(crate) fn find_min_local_version(
1880:         &self,
1881:         cb_combiner: Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>,
1882:     ) -> (result: (u64, Tracked<CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT>>))
1883:         requires
1884:             self.wf(),
1885:             cb_combiner@.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1886:             cb_combiner@.value().is_Idle(),
1887:         ensures
1888:             result.0 <= MAX_IDX,
1889:             result.1@.key() == cb_combiner@.key(),
1890:             result.1@.value().is_AdvancingHead(),
1891:             result.1@.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1892:             result.1@.value().get_AdvancingHead_idx() == self.num_replicas,
1893:             result.1@.value().get_AdvancingHead_min_local_version() == result.0,
1894:     {
1895:         let num_replicas = self.local_versions.len();
1896:         let tracked mut g_cb_comb_new: CyclicBuffer::combiner<DT> = cb_combiner.get();
1897:         let ghost g_node_id = cb_combiner@.key();
1898:         let mut min_local_version =
1899:             atomic_with_ghost!(
1900:             &self.local_versions[0].0 => load();
1901:             returning ret;
1902:             ghost g => {
1903:                 g_cb_comb_new = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow()
1904:                                         .advance_head_start(g_node_id, &g.1, g_cb_comb_new);
1905:             });
1906:         let mut idx: usize = 1;
1907:         while idx < num_replicas
1908:             invariant
1909:                 self.wf(),
1910:                 0 <= idx <= num_replicas,
1911:                 min_local_version <= MAX_IDX,
1912:                 g_cb_comb_new.instance_id() == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@.id(),
1913:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().is_AdvancingHead(),
1914:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().get_AdvancingHead_idx() == idx,
1915:                 g_cb_comb_new.value().get_AdvancingHead_min_local_version() == min_local_version,
1916:                 g_cb_comb_new.key() == g_node_id,
1917:                 num_replicas == self.local_versions.len(),
1918:             decreases num_replicas - idx
1919:         {
1920:             let cur_local_tail =
1921:                 atomic_with_ghost!(
1922:                 &self.local_versions[idx].0 => load();
1923:                 returning ret;
1924:                 ghost g => {
1925:                     g_cb_comb_new = self.cyclic_buffer_instance.borrow()
1926:                                             .advance_head_next(g_node_id, &g.1, g_cb_comb_new);
1927:                 });
1928:             if cur_local_tail < min_local_version {
1929:                 min_local_version = cur_local_tail;
1930:             }
1931:             idx = idx + 1;
1932:         }
1933:         (min_local_version, Tracked(g_cb_comb_new))
1934:     }
1935: }

1953:         nid: NodeId,
1954:         data: DT::View,
1955:         inst: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
1956:         cb_inst: CyclicBuffer::Instance<DT>,
1957:     ) -> bool {
1958:         &&& (forall|i| #![all_triggers]
1959:             0 <= i < self.request_ids@.len() ==> {
1960:                 &&& (self.local_updates@.contains_key(i))
1961:                 &&& self.local_updates@[i].instance_id() == inst.id()
1962:             })
1963:         &&& self.ghost_replica@.key() == nid
1964:         &&& self.ghost_replica@.instance_id() == inst.id()
1965:         &&& self.ghost_replica@.value() == data
1966:         &&& self.combiner@.key() == nid
1967:         &&& self.combiner@.instance_id() == inst.id()
1968:         &&& self.cb_combiner@.key() == nid
1969:         &&& self.cb_combiner@.instance_id() == cb_inst.id()
1970:         &&& self.request_ids@.len() <= MAX_REQUESTS

1989:             })

1995:     pub open spec fn append_post(
1996:         &self,
1997:         pre: Self,
1998:         nid: NodeId,
1999:         data: DT::View,

2001:         responses: Seq<DT::Response>,

2007:         &&& self.combiner@.value().is_Ready() ==> self.post_exec(pre.request_ids@, responses)
2008:         &&& self.combiner@.value().is_Placed() ==> self.pre_exec(responses)
2009:         &&& self.cb_combiner@.value()
2010:             == pre.cb_combiner@.value()  
2011:

2032:     pub open spec fn execute_post(
2033:         &self,
2034:         pre: Self,
2035:         nid: NodeId,
2036:         data: DT::View,
2037:         responses_old: Seq<DT::Response>,
2038:         responses: Seq<DT::Response>,

3058:     pub fn execute(
3059:         &self,
3060:         slog: &NrLog<DT>,
3061:         op: DT::ReadOperation,
3062:         tkn: ThreadToken<DT>,
3063:         ticket: Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>,
3064:     ) -> (result: (DT::Response, ThreadToken<DT>, Tracked<UnboundedLog::local_reads<DT>>))
3065:         requires
3066:             self.wf(),
3067:             slog.wf(),
3068:             tkn.wf(self),
3069:             tkn.batch_perm@@.pcell == self.contexts[tkn.thread_id_spec() as int].batch.0.id(),
3070:             self.replica_token@ == tkn.replica_token()@,
3071:             self.unbounded_log_instance@ == slog.unbounded_log_instance@,
3072:             self.cyclic_buffer_instance@ == slog.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
3073:             is_readonly_ticket(ticket@, op, slog.unbounded_log_instance@),
3074:         ensures
3075:             result.1.wf(&self),
3076:             result.1.batch_perm@@.pcell
3077:                 == self.contexts[result.1.thread_id_spec() as int].batch.0.id(),
3078:             is_readonly_stub(result.2@, ticket@.key(), result.0, slog.unbounded_log_instance@),
3079:     {
3080:         let ghost rid: nat = ticket@.key();
3081:         let ghost nid = tkn.replica_id_spec();
3082:         let (version_upper_bound, ticket) = slog.get_version_upper_bound(ticket);
3083:         let (mut is_synced, mut ticket) = slog.is_replica_synced_for_reads(
3084:             self.id(),
3085:             version_upper_bound,
3086:             ticket,
3087:         );
3088:         while !is_synced
3089:             invariant
3090:                 self.wf(),
3091:                 slog.wf(),
3092:                 !is_synced ==> ticket@.value().is_VersionUpperBound(),
3093:                 !is_synced ==> ticket@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_version_upper_bound()
3094:                     == version_upper_bound,
3095:                 !is_synced ==> ticket@.value().get_VersionUpperBound_op() == op,
3096:                 is_synced ==> ticket@.value().is_ReadyToRead(),
3097:                 is_synced ==> ticket@.value().get_ReadyToRead_node_id() == self.spec_id(),
3098:                 is_synced ==> ticket@.value().get_ReadyToRead_op() == op,
3099:                 ticket@.instance_id() == self.unbounded_log_instance@.id(),
3100:                 ticket@.key() == rid,
3101:                 slog.unbounded_log_instance@ == self.unbounded_log_instance@,
3102:                 slog.cyclic_buffer_instance@ == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
3103:         {
3104:             self.try_combine(slog);
3105:             spin_loop_hint();
3106:             let res = slog.is_replica_synced_for_reads(self.id(), version_upper_bound, ticket);
3107:             is_synced = res.0;
3108:             ticket = res.1;
3109:         }
3110:         let tracked ticket = ticket.get();
3111:         assert(tkn.thread_id_spec() < self.data.0.max_threads());
3112:         let read_handle = self.data.0.acquire_read(tkn.thread_id() as usize);
3113:         let replica = self.data.0.borrow(Tracked(&read_handle));
3114:         let result = replica.data.dispatch(op);
3115:         let tracked ticket = self.unbounded_log_instance.borrow().readonly_apply(
3116:             rid,
3117:             replica.replica.borrow(),
3118:             ticket,
3119:             replica.combiner.borrow(),
3120:         );
3121:         self.data.0.release_read(read_handle);
3122:         (result, tkn, Tracked(ticket))
3123:     }

3206:     fn get_response(
3207:         &self,
3208:         slog: &NrLog<DT>,
3209:         tid: ThreadId,
3210:         req_id: Ghost<ReqId>,
3211:         context_ghost: Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>,
3212:     ) -> (res: (DT::Response, Tracked<FCClientRequestResponseGhost<DT>>))
3213:         requires
3214:             self.wf(),
3215:             slog.wf(),
3216:             slog.unbounded_log_instance@ == self.unbounded_log_instance@,
3217:             slog.cyclic_buffer_instance@ == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
3218:             0 <= tid < self.contexts.len(),
3219:             context_ghost@.dequeue_resp_pre(
3220:                 self.contexts[tid as int].batch.0.id(),
3221:                 tid as nat,
3222:                 self.flat_combiner_instance@,
3223:             ),
3224:         ensures
3225:             res.1@.dequeue_resp_post(context_ghost@, Some(res.0), self.unbounded_log_instance@),
3226:     {
3227:         let mut context_ghost_new = context_ghost;
3228:         let context = &self.contexts[tid as usize];
3229:         let mut iter: usize = 0;
3230:         let mut r = None;
3231:         while r.is_none()
3232:             invariant
3233:                 slog.wf(),
3234:                 self.wf(),
3235:                 slog.unbounded_log_instance@ == self.unbounded_log_instance@,
3236:                 slog.cyclic_buffer_instance@ == self.cyclic_buffer_instance@,
3237:                 context.wf(tid as nat),
3238:                 context.flat_combiner_instance@ == self.flat_combiner_instance@,
3239:                 context.unbounded_log_instance@ == self.unbounded_log_instance@,
3240:                 0 <= iter <= RESPONSE_CHECK_INTERVAL,
3241:                 r.is_none() ==> context_ghost_new@.dequeue_resp_pre(
3242:                     context.batch.0.id(),
3243:                     tid as nat,
3244:                     self.flat_combiner_instance@,
3245:                 ),
3246:                 context_ghost_new@.dequeue_resp_post(
3247:                     context_ghost@,
3248:                     r,
3249:                     self.unbounded_log_instance@,
3250:                 ),
3251:         {
3252:             if iter == RESPONSE_CHECK_INTERVAL {
3253:                 self.try_combine(slog);
3254:                 iter = 0;
3255:             }
3256:             let deq_resp_result = context.dequeue_response(context_ghost_new);
3257:             r = deq_resp_result.0;
3258:             context_ghost_new = deq_resp_result.1;
3259:             iter = iter + 1;
3260:         }
3261:         let r = r.unwrap();
3262:         (r, context_ghost_new)
3263:     }

9: /*
10: Checks whether attribute contains instructions about completing a proof
11: */
12: fn is_proof_attr(attr: &syn_verus::Attribute) -> bool {
13:     attr.path().segments.len() > 1
14:     && attr.path().segments[0].ident.to_string() == "verifier"
15:     && (attr.path().segments[1].ident.to_string() == "rlimit"
16:         || attr.path().segments[1].ident.to_string() == "integer_ring"
17:         || attr.path().segments[1].ident.to_string() == "memoize"
18:         || attr.path().segments[1].ident.to_string() == "loop_isolation"
19:         || attr.path().segments[1].ident.to_string() == "spinoff_prover")
20: }
21: 
22: pub fn remove_proof_attr(attr: &Vec<syn_verus::Attribute>) -> Vec<syn_verus::Attribute> {
23:     attr.iter().filter(|a| !is_proof_attr(a)).map(|a| a.clone()).collect()
24: }

26: /// State-machine transition inductive functions are proof functions in Verus,
27: /// even though their source syntax omits the `proof` keyword.
28: fn is_inductive_fn(attrs: &[syn_verus::Attribute]) -> bool {
29:     attrs.iter().any(|attr| attr.path().is_ident("inductive"))
30: }
31: 
32: fn is_inductive_attribute(tokens: &[TokenTree], index: usize) -> bool {
33:     matches!(tokens.get(index), Some(TokenTree::Punct(p)) if p.as_char() == '#')
34:         && matches!(tokens.get(index + 1), Some(TokenTree::Group(group))
35:             if group.delimiter() == Delimiter::Bracket
36:                 && matches!(group.stream().into_iter().next(), Some(TokenTree::Ident(ident)) if ident == "inductive"))
37: }
38: 
39: fn inductive_body_index(tokens: &[TokenTree], attribute: usize) -> Option<usize> {
40:     if !is_inductive_attribute(tokens, attribute)
41:         || !matches!(tokens.get(attribute + 2), Some(TokenTree::Ident(ident)) if ident == "fn")
42:     {
43:         return None;
44:     }
45: 
46:     ((attribute + 3)..tokens.len()).find(|index| {
47:         matches!(tokens.get(*index), Some(TokenTree::Group(group)) if group.delimiter() == Delimiter::Brace)
48:     })
49: }
50: 
51: fn token_slices_are_equal(original: &[TokenTree], changed: &[TokenTree]) -> bool {
52:     original.len() == changed.len()
53:         && original.iter().zip(changed.iter()).all(|(original, changed)| {
54:             original.to_string() == changed.to_string()
55:         })
56: }

58: /// Compare state-machine macro tokens while allowing completion of only an
59: /// originally empty `#[inductive(...)] fn` body. All declaration tokens and
60: /// every non-target transition remain exact matches.
61: fn state_machine_tokens_are_safe(original: TokenStream, changed: TokenStream) -> bool {
62:     let original: Vec<TokenTree> = original.into_iter().collect();
63:     let changed: Vec<TokenTree> = changed.into_iter().collect();
64:     let mut original_index = 0;
65:     let mut changed_index = 0;
66: 
67:     while original_index < original.len() && changed_index < changed.len() {
68:         if is_inductive_attribute(&original, original_index)
69:             && is_inductive_attribute(&changed, changed_index)
70:         {
71:             if let (Some(original_body), Some(changed_body)) = (
72:                 inductive_body_index(&original, original_index),
73:                 inductive_body_index(&changed, changed_index),
74:             ) {
75:                 if !token_slices_are_equal(
76:                     &original[original_index..original_body],
77:                     &changed[changed_index..changed_body],
78:                 ) {
79:                     return false;
80:                 }
81:                 match (&original[original_body], &changed[changed_body]) {
82:                     (TokenTree::Group(original_group), TokenTree::Group(changed_group))
83:                         if original_group.delimiter() == Delimiter::Brace
84:                             && changed_group.delimiter() == Delimiter::Brace
85:                             && original_group.stream().is_empty() =>
86:                     {
87:                         original_index = original_body + 1;
88:                         changed_index = changed_body + 1;
89:                         continue;
90:                     }
91:                     _ => {}
92:                 }
93:             }
94:         }
95: 
96:         match (&original[original_index], &changed[changed_index]) {
97:             (TokenTree::Group(original_group), TokenTree::Group(changed_group))
98:                 if original_group.delimiter() == changed_group.delimiter() =>
99:             {
100:                 if !state_machine_tokens_are_safe(original_group.stream(), changed_group.stream()) {
101:                     return false;
102:                 }
103:             }
104:             (original_tree, changed_tree) if original_tree.to_string() == changed_tree.to_string() => {}
105:             _ => return false,
106:         }
107:         original_index += 1;
108:         changed_index += 1;
109:     }
110: 
111:     original_index == original.len() && changed_index == changed.len()
112: }

10: /// Remove only the proof block from a well-formed `atomic_with_ghost!` macro.
11: ///
12: /// The macro's target, operation, optional `update`/`returning` clauses, and
13: /// ghost binding are retained.  Returning `None` for an unfamiliar shape is
14: /// intentional: callers must then compare the macro unchanged.
15: fn normalized_atomic_with_ghost_tokens(tokens: &TokenStream) -> Option<TokenStream> {
16:     let mut trees: Vec<TokenTree> = tokens.clone().into_iter().collect();
17:     let ghost_positions: Vec<usize> = trees
18:         .iter()
19:         .enumerate()
20:         .filter_map(|(index, tree)| match tree {
21:             TokenTree::Ident(ident) if ident == "ghost" => Some(index),
22:             _ => None,
23:         })
24:         .collect();

26:     if ghost_positions.len() != 1 {
27:         return None;
28:     }
29: 
30:     let ghost = ghost_positions[0];
31:     // The supported Verus grammar ends in: `ghost <identifier> => { ... }`.
32:     if ghost + 5 != trees.len()
33:         || !matches!(&trees[ghost + 1], TokenTree::Ident(_))
34:         || !matches!(&trees[ghost + 2], TokenTree::Punct(p) if p.as_char() == '=')
35:         || !matches!(&trees[ghost + 3], TokenTree::Punct(p) if p.as_char() == '>')
36:     {
37:         return None;
38:     }
39: 
40:     let body = match &trees[ghost + 4] {
41:         TokenTree::Group(group) if group.delimiter() == Delimiter::Brace => group,
42:         _ => return None,
43:     };
44:     let mut empty_body = Group::new(Delimiter::Brace, TokenStream::new());
45:     empty_body.set_span(body.span());
46:     trees[ghost + 4] = TokenTree::Group(empty_body);
47:     Some(trees.into_iter().collect())

52: /// These macros interleave executable operations with ghost proof blocks. We
53: /// preserve every token except the contents of already-present proof blocks,
54: /// so proof completion cannot change an operation, binding, or other macro
55: /// structure.

57:     fn normalize_groups(tokens: TokenStream) -> (TokenStream, bool) {
58:         let mut trees: Vec<TokenTree> = tokens.into_iter().collect();
59:         let mut changed = false;
60:         let mut index = 0;
61: 
62:         while index < trees.len() {
63:             if matches!(&trees[index], TokenTree::Ident(ident) if ident == "proof") {
64:                 if let Some(TokenTree::Group(group)) = trees.get(index + 1) {
65:                     if group.delimiter() == Delimiter::Brace {
66:                         let mut empty = Group::new(Delimiter::Brace, TokenStream::new());
67:                         empty.set_span(group.span());
